productChange.change: Set actions/upload-artifact desktop-package compression-level from default 6 to 1 for ferrum-desktop-${runner.os}; evidence artifacts remain at default level 6.
productChange.why: The desktop artifact upload is measurable end-of-job work after real package/runtime smoke. The maintained upload action exposes compression-level directly, so Ferrum can reduce compression CPU without changing package contents, test scope, evidence, or runtime behavior.

wholeWorkflowContext.interpretation: Whole-workflow wall time was noisier/slower in this single comparison because unrelated hosted-runner/browser/setup timing varied. maximumImprovementChallenge.challenge: Could Ferrum remove artifact wrapper compression/extraction or add a cross-job evidence index immediately?
maximumImprovementChallenge.decision: Keep the one-line compression change as the only product change.
maximumImprovementChallenge.reason: DuckDB's current tar.gz + archive:false pattern is promising, but changing Ferrum's user-facing desktop transport requires full Linux+Windows package/upload/download/extract/fresh-launch proof first. A cross-job index needs measured agent-round-trip benefit and must not hide raw evidence. Dependency caching remains deferred until reproducible dependency identity/invalidation and stale-cache negative tests exist.

nextExperiments: Compare level-1 desktop transport with a Ferrum-produced precompressed single-file archive using upload-artifact@v7 archive:false; measure package, upload, bytes, download, extraction, permissions/identity and fresh launch on Linux+Windows.
Prototype a compact cross-job evidence index that retrieves only small manifests/summaries by artifact ID/digest, never large desktop packages; measure agent calls, response bytes and CI latency.
Establish deterministic dependency identity, runtime/toolchain keying, explicit invalidation and stale-cache negative tests before enabling dependency caches.
Resume process/sandbox isolation after transport/index work converges.
guardrails: No reduced browser/app/OS coverage, omitted evidence, lower diagnostics/image fidelity, caps, viewport-only shortcuts or synthetic substitution for real runtime proof.
Artifact transport may change compression only when packaged contents remain complete and fresh runtime proof stays green.
Derived indexes/reports remain additive; Ferrum-native evidence and provider artifact digests are authoritative.
